ZubCut Quick Network Diagnostic — paste into Command Prompt
============================================================

1) Tell her to open Command Prompt as Administrator:
   Start menu → type cmd → right-click → Run as administrator

2) Copy EVERYTHING in the box below (one line) and paste into that window, then press Enter.

3) Notepad should open a Desktop report — she screenshots the SUMMARY section.

----- COPY FROM HERE -----
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand 
----- COPY TO HERE -----

Notes:
- No ZubCut update or .bat/.ps1 file needed.
- If Notepad does not open, check Desktop for ZubCut-Quick-Diag-*.txt
- Support-only: not a user-facing app button.
